description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Rasputin Dreamweaver.
Activate Rasputin Dreamweaver's first activated ability seven times by removing seven dream counters from it, adding seven {C}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Eldrazi Displacer any number of times choosing any targets.
